 (parsed : AspisR1PrefixAggregateParser.r1_wire.Prefix.parse bytes=ok (.Ok pre))
 (row : U8) (N off : Usize) (live : row.val<27) (fields : 14≤row.val)
 (call : NGO_CallerDomains.Call row.val N.val off.val) :
 ∃ record,r1_wire.Prefix.validated_record (PrefixAdapter.fromOld pre) row=ok (.Ok record) ∧
 record.row=row ∧ Ready record N off
items.review: Parsed-success premise, live/fields bounds and exact NGO Call are local caller domains. FinishSlots supplies actual parsed branch/constants. Full bytes/record value used, not pointer identity.

items.source_statement:
theorem total (N off : Usize) (record : MainRecord)
 (call : NGO_CallerDomains.Call record.row.val N.val off.val)
 (geometry : record.framed.val.length=5+NFU_PacketDomains.payloadSize record.row.val)
 (strict : ∀ chunk∈(List.toChunksExact 32 (by decide) (record.framed.val.drop 5)).1,StrictLowChunk chunk) :
 ∃ out,decodeMain N record off=ok (.Ok out) ∧ NKQ_DecodeCanonical.MainRowCanon out
items.review: Call/length/strict chunk premises require record producer. RecordDomains derives these from actual parser branch; never adopted as unproved root preconditions.

theorem factor (ops : Ops) {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
 (public_bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (hash : H) (c : NHL_Tx1Stages.Context) :
 NHL_Tx1Stages.queryCut ops D public_bytes proof k hash none c =
 (do let r ← ops.op7 proof c.prepared c.accumulator c.scratch none c.geometry c.pending k
     afterQuery ops D public_bytes proof hash c.prepared r)
items.review: SOURCE SUPPORT ONLY. Arbitrary operation dictionaries/continuations and success/error premises describe local branch equations; they are not actual frozen native interpretations and are inadmissible as concrete row root premises. Full first-error/outer-abort cases are retained where stated; no full native log fold is concluded.
